title: Identifying novel transcript biomarkers for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) using RNA-Seq datasets and machine learning.
summary: Primary BMC Cancer Methods/Results used RNA-seq from 33 HCC cell models and machine-learning feature selection to nominate PARP2-202, SPON2-203 and CYREN-211; the work expressly has no patient or independent experimental biomarker validation. Approve only as a bounded cell-model transcript-discrimination result, not as clinically established biomarkers.
ai_technology: SVM/RFE and other classifiers select transcript features from HCC-vs-healthy cell-model RNA-seq; use of ML is explicit in Methods.

evidence.tested: Three transcripts discriminate HCC and healthy liver cell models in repeated cross-validation; paper reports the candidate signatures as putative biomarkers and explains the single-replicate limits.
evidence.unknown: Cross-validation and random transcript comparisons are internal model checks, not patient validation; exact narrow claim limited to cell models.
evidence.ai_role: SVM/RFE and other classifiers select transcript features from HCC-vs-healthy cell-model RNA-seq; use of ML is explicit in Methods.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
